lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 11 distinct high-contrast vertical line segments are visible on the primary reddish-brown torso mass. Spacing is relatively uniform across the mid-section with a slight increase in density on the posterior third of the flank.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The posterior-most line segments on the upper rump consist of abbreviated, dashed white blobs that do not extend to the ventral line. The 5th and 6th lines from the posterior terminate prematurely in the mid-lateral region.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of approximately 4 high-contrast white spots is visible on the upper posterior haunch. Another single spot is located lower on the thigh above the hock.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three spots on the posterior-most section of the haunch align in a vertical geometric orientation, mimicking the trajectory of the torso lines.

other_distinctive_markers: Bright white horizontal bands are visible on the distal segments of both forelimbs and the visible hind limb. A distinct white patch is visible on the lower ventral portion of the neck.
